annotations.title: Claim another host, or give one up

description: Claim another host for this site so its traffic counts, or give one up with `remove: true`. A DIFFERENT registrable domain must be proven on its own — publish this claim's challenge there too, then call again. Subdomains need no call at all: a claimed domain already covers them. Needs the site-config permission.

remove.description: Give the host up instead. Needs no proof — it only narrows what we listen to.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

name: cromanion_claim_domain

added.description: False when the host was already covered — not a failure.

claimed.description: Every host this site now listens to, after the change. The answer, whichever branch ran.

note.description: Present when nothing changed, saying why — usually that a claimed domain already covers this subdomain.

provedBy.description: Present when a fresh proof was read, which a different registrable domain requires.

removed.description: Present on a removal: the host given up.
